newsitem.title: USA: Bre-X Minerals Ltd faces class-action suit.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X Minerals Ltd faces class-action suit.

text.p: A New York law firm, Wechsler Harwood Halebian & Feffer LLP, said today that it has filed suit against Bre-X Minerals Ltd.

The firm said it is seeking class action status to recover damages for shareholders hurt by revelations that Bre-X's announcement of large gold reserves at it's Indonesian Busang project was materially overstated.

On March 26, Bre-X CEO David Walsh said "there appears to be a strong possibility that the potential gold resources on the Busang project in East Kalimantan, Indonesia have been overstated because of invalid samples and assaying of those samples."
When asked about the lawsuit, a Bre-X spokeswoman said, "I can't comment on anything."
